        chef_caught = False

        for i in range(N):
            if P[i] < C:
                # Officer is to the left of Chef
                if i > 0 and P[i] == P[i-1] + 1:
                    # Officer cannot move left
                    max_eliminated += 1
                elif i == 0 or P[i] != P[i-1] + 1:

            elif P[i] > C:

                    # Officer cannot move right
                    max_eliminated += 1
                elif i == N-1 or P[i] != P[i+1] - 1:
                    # Move officer to the left
                    P[i] -= 1
            else:
                # Officer is at Chef's position
                chef_caught = True
                break
        
        # Determine if Chef can run away
        if max_eliminated == N:
            result = 1
